name: What is the difference between a built-in banquette and a freestanding banquette?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a built-in banquette and a freestanding banquette?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in banquette is permanently affixed to a wall or floor, creating a seamless, integrated look and often maximizing space efficiency. A freestanding banquette, conversely, is a movable piece of furniture that can be relocated. The practical tradeoff lies in flexibility versus stability; built-in banquettes offer superior stability and a custom fit, while freestanding options provide the ability to reconfigure your space or move the seating if you relocate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Built-in banquettes are permanently installed for a seamless look, while freestanding banquettes are movable furniture.
